WITH STATIONS AS (
    SELECT 
      TRIM(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 1, 11))           AS STATION_ID,
      TRY_TO_DOUBLE(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 13, 8))  AS LATITUDE,
      TRY_TO_DOUBLE(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 22, 9))  AS LONGITUDE,
      TRY_TO_DOUBLE(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 32, 6))  AS ALTITUDE,
      TRIM(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 39, 2))           AS STATE,
      TRIM(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 42, 30))          AS NAME
    FROM AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.PUBLIC.raw_stations
    WHERE 1=1
       AND TRIM(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 1, 3)) = 'USW' -- ONLY GET STATIONS AT US AIRPORTS
    ),
    
    AIRPORTS AS (
    SELECT 
      AIRPORT_SEQ_ID,
      AIRPORT_ID,
      AIRPORT,
      DISPLAY_AIRPORT_NAME,
      DISPLAY_AIRPORT_CITY_NAME_FULL, 
      AIRPORT_COUNTRY_NAME,
      AIRPORT_COUNTRY_CODE_ISO,
      AIRPORT_STATE_NAME, 
      AIRPORT_STATE_CODE,
      DISPLAY_CITY_MARKET_NAME_FULL,
      LATITUDE, 
      LONGITUDE
    FROM AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.PUBLIC.raw_airport_coordinates
    WHERE 1=1
     AND AIRPORT_IS_LATEST = 1 -- FILTER FOR LAST ROW OF AIRPORT IN SOURCE
     AND AIRPORT_IS_CLOSED = 0 -- FILTER FOR OPEN AIRPORTS
     AND AIRPORT_COUNTRY_CODE_ISO = 'US' --FILTER FOR US AIRPORTS ONLY
    ),

    DISTANCE AS (
    SELECT
        a.AIRPORT_SEQ_ID,
        a.AIRPORT_ID,
        a.AIRPORT,
        a.DISPLAY_AIRPORT_NAME,
        a.DISPLAY_AIRPORT_CITY_NAME_FULL,
        a.AIRPORT_COUNTRY_NAME,
        a.AIRPORT_COUNTRY_CODE_ISO,
        a.AIRPORT_STATE_NAME, 
        a.AIRPORT_STATE_CODE,
        a.DISPLAY_CITY_MARKET_NAME_FULL,
        a.LATITUDE AIRPORT_LATITUDE,  
        a.LONGITUDE AIRPORT_LONGITUDE,
        
        s.STATION_ID,
        s.STATE AS STATION_STATE,
        s.NAME AS STATION_NAME,
        s.LATITUDE AS STATION_LATITUDE,
        s.LONGITUDE AS STATION_LONGITUDE,
        s.ALTITUDE AS STATION_ALTITUDE,
        HAVERSINE(a.LATITUDE, a.LONGITUDE, s.LATITUDE, s.LONGITUDE) AS DISTANCE_KM,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AIRPORT_ID ORDER BY HAVERSINE(a.LATITUDE, a.LONGITUDE, s.LATITUDE, s.LONGITUDE) ASC) AS ROW_NUM -- ROW_NUM TO DEDUPLICATE AIRPORTS BASED ON DISTANCE_KM
    FROM airports a
    LEFT JOIN stations s
    ON s.latitude BETWEEN a.latitude  - 0.5 AND a.latitude  + 0.5
    AND s.longitude BETWEEN a.longitude - 0.5 AND a.longitude + 0.5
    AND HAVERSINE(a.LATITUDE, a.LONGITUDE, s.LATITUDE, s.LONGITUDE) < 20 -- ONLY JOIN STATIONS WITHIN 20 KM FROM AIRPORT
    )
    
SELECT 
    AIRPORT_SEQ_ID,
    AIRPORT_ID,
    AIRPORT,
    DISPLAY_AIRPORT_NAME,
    DISPLAY_AIRPORT_CITY_NAME_FULL,
    AIRPORT_COUNTRY_NAME,
    AIRPORT_COUNTRY_CODE_ISO,
    AIRPORT_STATE_NAME, 
    AIRPORT_STATE_CODE,
    DISPLAY_CITY_MARKET_NAME_FULL,
    AIRPORT_LATITUDE,  
    AIRPORT_LONGITUDE,
    STATION_ID,
    STATION_STATE,
    STATION_NAME,
    STATION_LATITUDE,
    STATION_LONGITUDE,
    STATION_ALTITUDE,
    DISTANCE_KM
FROM DISTANCE
WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 -- DEDUPLICATE AIRPORTS WITH MORE THAN 1 STATION AND CHOOSE CLOSEST ONE

SELECT 
      TRIM(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 1, 11))           AS STATION_ID,
      TRY_TO_DOUBLE(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 13, 8))  AS LATITUDE,
      TRY_TO_DOUBLE(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 22, 9))  AS LONGITUDE,
      TRY_TO_DOUBLE(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 32, 6))  AS ALTITUDE,
      TRIM(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 39, 2))           AS STATE,
      TRIM(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 42, 30))          AS NAME
FROM AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.PUBLIC.raw_stations
WHERE 
    TRIM(SUBSTR(ALL_DATA, 1, 3)) = 'USW' -- ONLY GET STATIONS AT US AIRPORTS

SELECT 
    FLIGHTDATE,
    REPORTING_AIRLINE,
    carrier.DESCRIPTION AS CARRIER_NAME,
    ORIGINAIRPORTID,
    DESTAIRPORTID,
    DEPTIME,
    DEPDELAY,
    ARRTIME,
    ARRDELAY,
    CANCELLED,
    AIRTIME,
    WEATHERDELAY,
    NASDELAY,
    SECURITYDELAY,
    LATEAIRCRAFTDELAY
FROM AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.PUBLIC.raw_flights rf
LEFT JOIN AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.PUBLIC.raw_carrier_lookup carrier
ON rf.REPORTING_AIRLINE = carrier.CODE

SELECT 
    ID as STATION_ID, 
    TO_DATE(date::varchar, 'YYYYMMDD') as DATE,
    max(iff(element = 'PRCP', data_value / 10, null)) >= 25  as is_heavy_rain,
    max(iff(element = 'WSF5', data_value / 10 , null)) >= 15 as is_high_wind,
    max(iff(element = 'TMIN', data_value / 10 , null )) <= 0 as is_freezing,
    max(iff(element = 'PRCP', data_value / 10, null))  as precip_mm,
    max(iff(element = 'WSF5', data_value / 10, null))  as max_gust_ms,
    max(iff(element = 'TMIN', data_value / 10, null))  as tmin_c,
    max(iff(element = 'WT03', 1, 0)) = 1          as had_thunder,
    max(iff(element in ('WT01','WT02','WT21','WT22'), 1, 0)) = 1 as had_fog,
    max(iff(element in ('WT06','WT15','WT17'), 1, 0)) = 1        as had_icing
FROM AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.PUBLIC.raw_weather
WHERE ID like 'USW%' -- FILTER FOR STATIONS AT AIRPORTS
GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT 
    airport,
    display_airport_name,
    display_airport_city_name_full
FROM AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.PUBLIC.raw_airport_coordinates AS raw_airports
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_airports AS dim_airports
    WHERE dim_airports.airport_id = raw_airports.airport_id
)
AND AIRPORT_IS_LATEST = 1 -- FILTER FOR LAST ROW OF AIRPORT IN SOURCE
AND AIRPORT_IS_CLOSED = 0 -- FILTER FOR OPEN AIRPORTS
AND AIRPORT_COUNTRY_CODE_ISO = 'US' --FILTER FOR US AIRPORTS ONLY

select AIRPORT_ID
from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_airports
where AIRPORT_ID is null

select
    AIRPORT_ID as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_airports
where AIRPORT_ID is not null
group by AIRPORT_ID
having count(*) > 1

select LATITUDE
from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_stations
where LATITUDE is null

select LONGITUDE
from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_stations
where LONGITUDE is null

select STATION_ID
from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_stations
where STATION_ID is null

select
    STATION_ID as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_stations
where STATION_ID is not null
group by STATION_ID
having count(*) > 1

select DATE
from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.fact_weather
where DATE is null

select STATION_ID
from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.fact_weather
where STATION_ID is null

with child as (
    select STATION_ID as from_field
    from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.fact_weather
    where STATION_ID is not null
),

parent as (
    select STATION_ID as to_field
    from AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_stations
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

SELECT 
    ff.flightdate,
    ff.carrier_name,
    ff.originairportid,
    ff.destairportid,
    ff.arrdelay,
    ff.weatherdelay,
    da_orig.display_airport_name orig_airport_name,
    da_orig.display_airport_city_name_full orig_city,
    da_orig.distance_km orig_dist_airport_station,
    (fw_orig.is_heavy_rain OR fw_orig.is_high_wind OR fw_orig.is_freezing OR fw_orig.precip_mm > 25) orig_bad_weather,
    (fw_orig.had_thunder OR fw_orig.had_fog OR fw_orig.had_icing) as orig_other_weather_issue,
    da_dest.display_airport_name dest_airport_name,
    da_dest.display_airport_city_name_full dest_city,
    da_dest.distance_km dest_dist_airport_station,
    (fw_dest.is_heavy_rain OR fw_dest.is_high_wind OR fw_dest.is_freezing OR fw_dest.precip_mm > 25) dest_bad_weather,
    (fw_dest.had_thunder OR fw_dest.had_fog OR fw_dest.had_icing) as dest_other_weather_issue
FROM AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.fact_flights ff
LEFT JOIN AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_airports da_dest
ON ff.DESTAIRPORTID = da_dest.AIRPORT_ID
LEFT JOIN AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.dim_airports da_orig
ON ff.ORIGINAIRPORTID = da_orig.AIRPORT_ID
JOIN AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.fact_weather fw_dest
ON fw_dest.date = ff.flightdate      -- MATCH ON THE WEATHER FOR EACH DATE
AND da_dest.STATION_ID = fw_dest.STATION_ID -- ONLY GET WEATHER FROM AIRPORTS WITH CLOSE STATION
JOIN AVIATION_WEATHER_PROJECT.DEV.fact_weather fw_orig
ON fw_orig.date = ff.flightdate      -- MATCH ON THE WEATHER FOR EACH DATE
AND da_orig.STATION_ID = fw_orig.STATION_ID -- ONLY GET WEATHER FROM AIRPORTS WITH CLOSE STATION
